policy.fixed_material: Unchanged actual questions and predetermined answer-key.json; source-reference-appendix.json exact file-specific locators supersede historical approximate inline ranges. No input was edited.
policy.correct: All actually requested material clauses are answered correctly, accepting semantic equivalents and reasonable contextual wording.
policy.partial: A requested material part is missing or abstained from, with no false ruling.
policy.incorrect: A false ruling or contradiction, including any volunteered gameplay ruling, overrides otherwise correct parts.
policy.scope: Inspect timing, costs, destinations, quantities, consequences and exceptions relevant to actual wording. Do not add incidental key background or formatting requirements as requested parts. An abstention on an unasked detail is not a failure.
policy.evidence: Assess answer and its own same-question evidence together, independently of supplied support labels. Evidence may supply a fact or introduce a contradiction; a bare section citation supplies no omitted fact. No cross-answer borrowing.
policy.unsupported_guess: Separately flag source-correct claims unsupported by the frozen summary; poor phrasing alone is not evidence of guessing.

questions_key_reference_and_responses.method: Decoded and read complete metadata plus each complete array object, including all reference fields, in compact serialization.
